description: Body-on-frame seven-seat SUV built on the Hilux platform, common with middle-class Thai families.

image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Body-on-frame seven-seat SUV, tall boxy cabin with a full rear hatch and roof rails, four doors with chrome window trim, swept headlamps into a wide grille, flared arches over alloy wheels, side steps Materials: Pearl or dark metallic paint, chrome grille and door handles, tinted rear glass, dusty lower doors and arches, light road film on the rear hatch.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless neutral 50% grey (#808080). The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop, photographed as a cut-out with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Real trademark: Toyota Fortuner / Toyota Motor. The repo's MIT licence covers this asset's code, not the mark; anyone shipping it needs their own trademark clearance.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.85. 3,984/4,000 triangles, 4/4 draw calls, 3/3 materials, 4/6 unique geometries, two canvases (512 px dust, 256 px glass) at 1.7 MB, factory 61 ms.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope built at 1.86 x 1.84 x 4.80 m over the body (mirrors to 2.08) against the declared 1.86 x 1.84 x 4.80; the proxy is 2.47 lengths tall against the real 2.61, a 5 percent declared-aspect residual on the band table.
featureReviews.notes: Heights off the proxy side elevation (roof 1.00 H, belt 0.60 H, wheel top 0.40 H, sill 0.24 H); stations bonnet 0.03-0.27 L, screen to 0.36 L, roof to 0.97 L, near-vertical hatch; roof rails seated on the roof after the first build floated them 2.5-5 cm and the turntable gate read the daylight under them as a 567 x 12 px hole on both flanks.

featureReviews.evidence: Two-bar chrome grille between rectangular lamps over a grey bumper; chrome side steps, roof rails, hatch garnish and spare bulge, mirrors, chrome handles, shut lines. The front is built to type: the plate is a rear three-quarter.
featureReviews.notes: Built as tinted boxes on one white material, each standing proud of the shell.

featureReviews.evidence: Four instanced wheels off one lathe with the rim a step apart from the tyre; pivots wheel-front-l/r and wheel-rear-l/r on the axle at each hub, exposed on sculptRuntime.
featureReviews.notes: Alloy wheels in the plate (region-rim 0.86): rim #b8b8b4 with a shallow 0.35 dish against tyre #53534e.

featureReviews.evidence: Paint measured #3f3e3a (region-side, 0.86) and shipped at #5a5a5e after two darker builds (#3f3e3a, #4c4c50) failed the turntable gate with the shaded flank read as a 734 x 140 px hole; dust envelope #86837e on the material, clean grey as a linear ratio on a 512 px canvas.
featureReviews.notes: Fidelity on this layer is held down by the lift: the prop is visibly lighter than the plate and says so on the material.
